caption: The drawing displays a rectangular, tapering structure resembling a planter, rendered in light beige and gray tones. In the center of the longer visible side, there is a circular medallion with the profile of a helmeted head depicted in darker gray lines. The planter appears to have a molded rim at the top and a slightly protruding base. Two additional technical sketches are shown below the main drawing: one is a simple square labeled with the dimension “22” and quotation marks indicating inches, and the other is a side profile cross-section illustrating the taper and molding details. The drawing uses fine lines and subtle shading to suggest depth and show the form of the object. The background is off-white, and the overall composition is functional with the object centered and the technical diagrams placed below.
title: Urn Design
